question: A tank level transmitter is scaled 4-20 mA to 0-100 %. The high level alarm setpoint is 70 % and the alarm uses a 2 % deadband. In at most 90 words: at what percentage does the alarm turn on, at what percentage does it turn off, then give exactly one IEC 61131-3 Structured Text line implementing it with a REAL variable Level and a BOOL variable Alarm.

rows.content:
The alarm turns on at 72% and turns off at 68%. This creates a 2% deadband around the 70% setpoint to prevent oscillation.

```iecst
Alarm := (Level >= 72.0) OR (Alarm AND Level > 68.0);
```
